process.title: How It Works
process.subtitle: Our simple and transparent treatment process

steps.title: Panoramic X-Ray & Diagnosis
steps.body: We start with a full 3D scan of your mouth. Dr. Arlind reviews it personally and maps out a clear treatment plan tailored to your case.

steps.title: Free Online Consultation
steps.body: We set up a video call so you can meet the doctor from home. He walks you through the results, answers your questions and confirms the plan. No need to travel just for a chat.

steps.title: Fly to Albania & Implant Surgery
steps.body: You arrive in Tirana and we take care of everything. Airport pickup, clinic welcome and the implant surgery, done under local anaesthetic, comfortable and precise.

steps.title: Temporary Teeth Fitted
steps.body: Right after surgery, temporary teeth are fitted so you leave the clinic with a full smile. You head home looking great while the implants bond with the bone.

steps.title: Final Crown Placed
steps.body: Once healing is complete, your custom porcelain crowns are placed. The result feels completely natural and is built to last for decades.

steps.title: X-Ray & Assessment
steps.body: We take a full digital scan and Dr. Arlind assesses the condition of the tooth to confirm a crown is the right solution for you.

steps.title: Free Online Consultation
steps.body: A video call with the doctor where he explains the procedure, answers all your questions and gives you a clear picture of what to expect.

steps.title: Fly to Albania & Tooth Preparation
steps.body: You arrive and we begin. The tooth is shaped to receive the crown. A temporary crown is placed while your permanent one is crafted in the lab.

steps.title: Temporary Crown Fitted
steps.body: You wear the temporary crown comfortably while the lab produces your final piece to the exact shape, size and shade you agreed on.

steps.title: Final Porcelain Crown Placed
steps.body: Your permanent crown is bonded in place. We check the fit, bite and aesthetics. The result looks and feels like a natural tooth.

steps.title: Smile Design Consultation
steps.body: We create a digital preview of your new smile before anything is touched. You choose the colour, shape and size. You see the result before we begin.

steps.title: Free Online Consultation
steps.body: A video call to go over your smile design, answer questions and confirm you are comfortable with the plan before booking your trip.

steps.title: Fly to Albania & Preparation
steps.body: You arrive and treatment begins. We remove only 0.3-0.5mm from the tooth surface, the least invasive approach compared to traditional crowns.

steps.title: Temporary Veneers Fitted
steps.body: Temporary veneers go on so you can preview the final look in real life. Any small adjustments are made before the permanent ones are produced.

steps.title: Final Veneers Bonded
steps.body: Your precision lab-made veneers are bonded with specialist adhesive. The transformation is immediate, natural and built to last.

about.title: About the Clinic
about.subtitle: 15 years of experience in international-level dental care
about.story: Maxillodent was founded in 2009 with a clear mission: to offer Albanian and international patients world-class dental care. Today, with over 5,000 satisfied patients and a team of 12 specialist doctors, we are the leading dental clinic in Albania.
about.mission: Our mission is to transform the smiles and lives of our patients by offering excellent dental care, the latest technology and personalised service.

treatments.title: Our Treatments
treatments.subtitle: The full range of dental services

implants.title: Dental Implants
implants.desc: A dental implant is the best permanent solution for replacing missing teeth. Made from medical-grade titanium, the implant integrates with the jawbone creating a strong base for the artificial crown.

crowns.title: Dental Crowns & Bridges
crowns.desc: A dental crown is a protective cap placed over a damaged tooth. It restores the shape, size and function of the tooth while protecting it from further damage.

veneers.title: Dental Veneers
veneers.desc: Veneers are ultra-thin porcelain layers bonded to the tooth surface. They give a dramatic smile transformation with minimal intervention.

allOn6.title: All-on-6 Implants
allOn6.desc: All-on-6 is the revolutionary solution for patients who have lost all their teeth or have severely damaged teeth. With just 6 implants we support the entire dental arch.

howItWorks.title: Your Journey to a Perfect Smile
howItWorks.subtitle: From the first scan to your final crown, we guide you through every step
howItWorks.stepsSubtitle: A clear, transparent process designed around your comfort and convenience

steps.title: Panoramic X-Ray and Diagnosis
steps.desc: We start with a full panoramic X-ray, a 3D scan of your entire mouth. Dr. Arlind Myftari reviews it personally and maps out exactly what needs to be done. No guesswork, just a clear plan.

steps.title: Free Online Consultation
steps.desc: We set up a video call so you can meet Dr. Arlind face to face from your own home. He walks you through the X-ray results, answers your questions, and confirms the treatment plan. No need to fly over just for a chat.

steps.title: Fly to Albania and Begin Treatment
steps.desc: You arrive in Tirana and we take care of everything from there. Airport pickup, clinic welcome, and the first stage of implant surgery. The procedure is done under local anaesthetic and most patients are surprised by how straightforward it is.

steps.title: Temporary Teeth Fitted
steps.desc: Right after the implants go in, we fit you with a set of temporary teeth so you leave the clinic with a full smile. You head home looking great while the implants quietly bond with the bone over the coming weeks.

steps.title: Your Permanent Smile
steps.desc: Once healing is complete, you come back for the final crowns. These are custom-made porcelain pieces crafted to match the shape and colour that suits you best. The result feels completely natural and is built to last for decades.

bio.title: About Dr. Arlind Myftari
bio.subtitle: Maxillofacial Surgeon & University Professor
bio.body1: Dr. Arlind Myftari is a dental and maxillofacial specialist with over 15 years of experience, known for his personalised approach and results that speak for themselves. He trained in Europe, works with premium implant systems trusted across the continent, and has built a reputation that travels well beyond Albania's borders. His patients come from the UK, Italy, Germany, Switzerland and beyond, many of them referred by someone who had already sat in his chair.
bio.body2: Outside the clinic, Dr. Myftari teaches at university level, training the next generation of dental surgeons. It says something about a doctor when his peers trust him to shape the profession. His approach is straightforward: listen carefully, explain clearly, and never recommend more than what the patient actually needs.
